_rule: Card step 4 (docs/card-design.md section 8, check 2). The named cases the guard must flag TODAY, each with the verdict test/card-parity.test.tsx reads off the real popup AND computes from the ledger (scripts/lib/card-scope.mjs). SHRINK-ONLY, checked both ways: a case whose verdict changes fails (update it only in the commit that changes that popup), and a case that is now right fails until its entry is removed. Never add an entry to make a red test green.

cases.why: owner case 1: the Feats-tab popup drops the page's Frequency and Trigger lines (hideMeta drops the leading Source column whole), so it reads as a free action usable any time
owner case 2: the Duration row prints the field's "1 minute" where the page prints "sustained up to 1 minute", and an Area row the page does not print
owner case 3: the record's tree is the whole Cloistered Cleric page, every doctrine level on it
owner case 4: "Area 1 cubic foot" is printed in the prose (the description's bold preamble), not in the stat rows
a heritage row: FeatDetail reads classFeatures by the slug of the heritage's name, finds nothing, and falls back to the old text while the heritages bucket holds its page
a wizard's Expert Spellcaster row shows the shared record's page, which is the Psychic's
the builder background picker opens its popup with key 'origin', a bucket that does not exist, so every background falls back to the old text
a hidden Bag of Devouring wears Spacious Pouch's name and text, but the popup reads the cursed item's own page by its id
trained Treat Wounds from the Main tab: the page's Requirements line is dropped with the header, and nothing says what the trained rank gives
